resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Former Fire Lookout Sites register and firelookout.com date the L-4 cab to 1933. The Forest Lookouts history says an L-4 ground cabin was constructed in 1934. We kept 1933 as the first date and recorded 1934 as the conflicting source.

notes_for_editor: Build year conflicts (1933 vs 1934). No source describes the site today or its access. An unverified Facebook group comment surfaced in search results about the structure and the 1970s; not used because the page could not be read and the claim is unsourced. Record's ground kind and L-4 design match the sources.
